roles.Name: Travel Transportation Specialist
roles.Responsibility: Determine the best mode of transportation for intercity travel based on the travel itinerary and preferences.
roles.Policy: 1. Review the travel itinerary and preferences. 2. Analyze options: Flight, Self-driving, Taxi. 3. Select the most suitable transportation mode for each leg of the journey. 4. Document the transportation choices in a structured format.

roles.Name: Accommodation Coordinator
roles.Responsibility: Plan accommodations for each city based on the travel schedule and number of travelers.
roles.Policy: 1. Review the travel itinerary and number of travelers. 2. Research suitable accommodations in each city. 3. Check availability and pricing for the recommended accommodations. 4. Document the accommodation details including number of rooms needed.

roles.Name: Dining Planner
roles.Responsibility: Select restaurants for each meal during the trip, ensuring they fit the travel schedule and preferences.
roles.Policy: 1. Review the travel itinerary and meal preferences. 2. Research and select one restaurant for each meal per day. 3. Ensure restaurant choices are within proximity to attractions or accommodations. 4. Document the restaurant selections in a structured format.

roles.Name: Attraction Curator
roles.Responsibility: Identify and recommend attractions for each day of the trip based on the travel itinerary.
roles.Policy: 1. Review the travel itinerary and available time slots for attractions. 2. Research attractions in each city. 3. Select appropriate attractions for each day, ensuring they fit the schedule. 4. Document the attraction recommendations in a structured format.

roles.Name: Travel Plan Integrator
roles.Responsibility: Compile all components (transportation, accommodation, dining, attractions) into a cohesive travel plan.
roles.Policy: 1. Gather outputs from all roles: Transportation, Accommodation, Dining, and Attractions. 2. Organize the information into a structured travel plan format. 3. Review the complete travel plan for coherence and completeness. 4. Finalize and present the travel plan.

def forward(team):

    # Step 2: Accommodation Coordinator plans accommodations based on transportation choices.
    accommodation_details = team.call('Accommodation Coordinator', [transportation_choices], "Accommodation details including number of rooms needed for each city.")
    
    # Step 3: Dining Planner selects restaurants based on accommodation details.
    restaurant_selections = team.call('Dining Planner', [accommodation_details], "Restaurant selections for each meal per day.")
    
    # Step 4: Attraction Curator recommends attractions based on accommodation details.
    attraction_recommendations = team.call('Attraction Curator', [accommodation_details], "Attraction recommendations for each day.")
    
    # Step 5: Travel Plan Integrator compiles all components into a cohesive travel plan.
    travel_plan = team.call('Travel Plan Integrator', [transportation_choices, accommodation_details, restaurant_selections, attraction_recommendations], "Finalized detailed travel plan.")
    
    # Return the finalized travel plan
    return travel_plan
